title: 数据清洗
objective: 识别重复、缺失、异常和格式不一致。

knowledgePoints.title: 识别重复与去重规则
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 定义疑似重复键，定位重复明细并制定可复核的保留规则。
knowledgePoints.concept: 技术重复与业务重复不同。同样金额或商品可能属于合法的多次交易；名称经清洗后相同也不证明是同一笔。应先确定业务键、规范化规则和保留优先级，再定位待核实记录。

columns.name: name
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.name: amount
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.name: category
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT TRIM(name) AS clean_name,amount,LOWER(category) AS clean_category,COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count FROM raw_data GROUP BY TRIM(name),amount,LOWER(category) HAVING COUNT(*)>1;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT TRIM(name) AS clean_name,amount,LOWER(category) AS clean_category,COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count FROM raw_data GROUP BY TRIM(name),amount,LOWER(category) HAVING COUNT(*)>1;
knowledgePoints.useCase: 导入清单需要找出相同清洗后名称、金额文本及类别的记录；该组合仅是筛查条件，不是已确认的交易唯一键。
knowledgePoints.comparison: DISTINCT 去除完全相同的输出行，不提供业务重复证据。

commonError.example: 直接删除金额相同或候选键相同的记录。
commonError.correction: 先审核业务凭证与唯一编号，再确定保留规则。

knowledgePoints.notes: 金额当前为文本，15与15.00可能被分成不同组；正式口径应先安全规范金额。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

teaching.problem: 导入清单需要找出相同清洗后名称、金额文本及类别的记录；该组合仅是筛查条件，不是已确认的交易唯一键。
teaching.codeExplanation: TRIM 清理名称边缘空格，LOWER 统一类别大小写，GROUP BY 使用同一表达式形成候选组，HAVING 筛出计数大于1的组。明细定位可通过窗口计数保留原编号；确认重复后才按批准规则选择保留行。
teaching.resultExplanation: 编号1和2属于同一疑似重复组，计数2。其余四条不符合该规则；这不排除其他业务异常。

mergeExamples.label: 定位重复明细
mergeExamples.explanation: 窗口计数保留原始编号，外层筛选疑似重复。
mergeExamples.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT id,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY TRIM(name),amount,LOWER(category)) AS n FROM raw_data) SELECT id,n FROM d WHERE n>1 ORDER BY n DESC;

mergeExamples.label: 模拟保留顺序
mergeExamples.explanation: 仅预览候选中的后续记录；编号小不代表数据质量一定更高。
mergeExamples.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TRIM(name),amount,LOWER(category) ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM raw_data) SELECT id,rn FROM d WHERE rn>1 ORDER BY rn DESC;

knowledgePoints.title: 缺失与异常检测
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 将数据质量规则转换为可审查标签，区分缺失、异常和合法零值。
knowledgePoints.concept: 缺失代表数据未提供；异常是违反规则或需要核实的记录。负金额可能是退款，零金额可能是赠品，不应自动纠正。条件分类只返回首个命中的标签；多异常审计可以为每项规则生成独立标记。
knowledgePoints.syntax: CASE WHEN condition THEN label ELSE other END

parameters.condition: 已经定义的数据质量规则

columns.name: name
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.name: amount
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.name: category
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT id,CASE WHEN name IS NULL OR TRIM(name)='' THEN '名称缺失' WHEN amount IS NULL THEN '金额缺失' WHEN CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2))<0 THEN '负金额待核' ELSE '通过' END AS quality FROM raw_data ORDER BY name DESC;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT id,CASE WHEN name IS NULL OR TRIM(name)='' THEN '名称缺失' WHEN amount IS NULL THEN '金额缺失' WHEN CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2))<0 THEN '负金额待核' ELSE '通过' END AS quality FROM raw_data ORDER BY name DESC;
knowledgePoints.useCase: 导入数据中金额文本已知为合法整数或空值，检查名称缺失、金额缺失及负金额。零值暂视为允许。
knowledgePoints.comparison: 单一分类适合汇总首要原因；独立标记适合同时检出多个问题。

commonError.example: 把负金额直接改为0，或依赖 CAST 判断非法文本是否合法。
commonError.correction: 保留原值，建立符合业务的数据格式检查与人工复核。

knowledgePoints.notes: 普通 TRIM 不覆盖所有 Unicode 空白；样例不含非法数字。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

teaching.problem: 导入数据中金额文本已知为合法整数或空值，检查名称缺失、金额缺失及负金额。零值暂视为允许。
teaching.codeExplanation: 先判断名称为空或去除普通空格后为空，再判断金额是否缺失，最后比较转换后的金额。保留原始编号用于回查。实际来源若可能含非法数字文本，必须先验证格式，不能把转换结果零当成合法输入。
teaching.resultExplanation: 编号3金额缺失，4负金额待核，6名称缺失；1、2、5通过本组规则。通过不等于已经完成全部质量审核。

mergeExamples.label: 独立质量标记
mergeExamples.sql: SELECT id,CASE WHEN name IS NULL OR TRIM(name)='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_name,CASE WHEN amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_amount,CASE WHEN CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2))<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS negative_amount FROM raw_data ORDER BY name DESC;

mergeExamples.label: 统计缺失数量
mergeExamples.explanation: 按各规则独立汇总，不将计数相加解释为唯一异常记录数。
mergeExamples.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN name IS NULL OR TRIM(name)='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_names,SUM(CASE WHEN amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_amounts FROM raw_data;

knowledgePoints.title: 类型转换与类别标准化
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 区分格式清理、类型转换及类别映射，保留原始值以便审计。
knowledgePoints.concept: 类型转换解决数据如何参与计算；类别标准化解决不同写法是否代表同一业务类别。转换前应验证输入格式与允许范围；映射规则应明确未知类别处理。SQLite 的 DECIMAL 类型亲和性不等于 MySQL 的精确十进制类型。
knowledgePoints.syntax: CAST(expr AS DECIMAL(12,2)); CASE WHEN condition THEN value ELSE other END

parameters.condition: 标准化后的类别匹配条件

columns.name: name
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.name: amount
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.name: category
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: SELECT id,CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS numeric_amount,CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='skin' THEN '护肤品' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='home' THEN '日用品' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='makeup' THEN '化妆品' ELSE '待分类' END AS clean_category FROM raw_data ORDER BY name DESC;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: SELECT id,CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS numeric_amount,CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='skin' THEN '护肤品' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='home' THEN '日用品' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='makeup' THEN '化妆品' ELSE '待分类' END AS clean_category FROM raw_data ORDER BY name DESC;
knowledgePoints.useCase: 将不同系统导入的金额和类别转换为报表口径。本例金额为合法整数文本或空值，类别字典包含护肤品、日用品、化妆品。
knowledgePoints.comparison: 类型转换不保证格式合法，类别映射不代表记录通过全部质量检查。

commonError.example: CAST 任意文本后直接汇总并忽略转换异常。
commonError.correction: 先验证合法格式与范围，隔离非法值，保留原值及转换状态。

knowledgePoints.notes: 示例类别大小写仅涉及 ASCII；本地数值精度与原生数据库不同。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

teaching.problem: 将不同系统导入的金额和类别转换为报表口径。本例金额为合法整数文本或空值，类别字典包含护肤品、日用品、化妆品。
teaching.codeExplanation: CAST 将金额转换为可计算值；LOWER(TRIM(category)) 先生成标准比较键，CASE 将已知键映射为中文类别，其他标为待分类。生产金额应采用真正的精确十进制或经过设计的整数分；不得把未知类别默认归为已知类别。
teaching.resultExplanation: 前三行统一为护肤品；编号3金额仍为空，编号4保留负数，编号5保留零。六行不改变粒度，清洗不等于去重。

mergeExamples.label: 保留原类别与标准键
mergeExamples.explanation: 先核对映射依据，避免清洗后无法追查。
mergeExamples.sql: SELECT id,category,LOWER(TRIM(category)) AS normalized FROM raw_data ORDER BY name DESC;

mergeExamples.label: 非法文本转换反例
mergeExamples.explanation: 仅展示本地数据库的风险：非法文本可能转成零，不能视作校验成功。
mergeExamples.sql: SELECT CAST('abc' AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS converted,CAST('0' AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS legitimate_zero;

summary: 完成本章后：识别重复、缺失、异常和格式不一致。
